<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak at m/z ≈ 100 with a +1 Da peak at ~5.6 % intensity and much smaller +2, +3, etc., peaks—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution (≈1.1 % per carbon). No characteristic Cl (3:1 M+2), Br (≈1:1 M+2), or S (≈4 % M+2) patterns are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
